name: Stockpile
tagline: Race your stock down before anyone else.
howToPlay: The stock pile in front of you is the only thing that matters — hand and discards exist to help you empty it. A turn spent playing from your hand while your stock's top card sits there is usually a turn wasted.

The draw pile is small — twenty-two cards at a table of four — and every discard buries a card until the ones above it come off. When it runs out and no build pile has completed to refill it, the cards under everyone's discard tops are shuffled into a new draw pile, so the deal keeps breathing. The top card of every discard pile stays where it is.
credits: An original sequencing pack: race to empty your stock onto shared build piles that count 1 through 12.
